A cozy Ball to befriend Pokémon.

Luxury Ball doubles the rate at which a Pokémon gains friendship. The catch rate is the same as a regular Poké Ball, but the friendship boost makes a real difference for evolution grinding.

Perfect for Pokémon that evolve through high friendship. Combine with other friendship-boosting methods like walking, vitamins, or the Soothe Bell for the fastest possible evolution. Also has a pretty black-and-gold design!
